body:
## Pull request overview

This PR completely removes the `examples/hotcrm` git submodule and all supporting infrastructure from the ObjectUI repository. The cleanup ensures the console application now builds and runs exclusively with built-in examples (CRM, Todo, Kitchen Sink), removing external dependencies on the HotCRM submodule.

**Changes:**
- Removed `.gitmodules` file and the `examples/hotcrm` submodule reference
- Deleted the dynamic import bridge (`examples/hotcrm-bridge.js` and `.d.ts`) and AI stub (`examples/hotcrm-stubs/ai.ts`)
- Cleaned workspace configuration, build configs, and example merge logic to remove all HotCRM references

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.gitmodules` | Deleted git submodule configuration for HotCRM |
| `examples/hotcrm` | Removed submodule reference |
| `examples/hotcrm-bridge.js` | Deleted dynamic import bridge for HotCRM plugin metadata extraction |
| `examples/hotcrm-bridge.d.ts` | Deleted TypeScript declarations for the bridge |
| `examples/hotcrm-stubs/ai.ts` | Deleted stub implementation for `@hotcrm/ai` package |
| `pnpm-workspace.yaml` | Removed HotCRM workspace glob patterns |
| `objectstack.config.ts` | Removed HotCRM comments and commented-out merge logic |
| `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts` | Removed HotCRM import, `mergeObjects()` function usage, and `hotcrmApps` references; updated comment |
| `apps/console/vite.config.ts` | Removed `@hotcrm/ai` resolve alias |
| `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` | Removed HotCRM submodule fallback mention from feature checklist |
</details>
